1.consolidated_definition: Insecto volador de hasta 27 mm de longitud, de cuerpo estrecho y aplanado, color pardo, con dos manchas amarillentas a los lados del tórax. Elateridae, Pyrophorus luminosus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Flying insect up to 27 mm in length, with a narrow and flattened body, brown color, and two yellowish spots on the sides of the thorax. Elateridae, Pyrophorus luminosus.
